summary: Ships remote-shell agent that bridges PTY sessions to an author-operated WebRTC relay
details: The package delivers a 12MB ARM64 Go ELF at bin/sxt that is a WebRTC-based remote-control agent. The binary embeds pion webrtc/dtls/ice/sctp and coder/websocket, spawns PTYs, wraps Codex/Claude CLI executors, and handles remote 'approvalDecision' messages, allowing a remote peer to drive shells and PTYs on the installer's host. It signals to a hardcoded relay at wss://relay.sextant.top and posts to https://relay.sextant.top/install. The binary also contains string literals for http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status (public-IP geolocation) and https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models together with the sk-ant- token prefix, consistent with host fingerprinting and probing for locally-present Anthropic API keys alongside the remote-shell channel. package.json's license field points at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, tying the publisher identity to a repository named 'claude_control' under the account 'ddos798'.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
